originStory.title: Why I Built This
originStory.subtitle: From drowning to systems that actually work
originStory.story: I didn't create the Knowledge Worker Kit because I'm naturally organized. I created it because I was drowning. As a shy, introverted teenager, I found refuge in writing and building websites. Decades later, I was still struggling. A failed startup cost me 200k euros and two years. I burned out trying to do everything through sheer willpower. The transition from introverted engineer to leader was painful. Three kids while building a business. Losing loved ones and questioning what really matters. These experiences forced me to build systems that actually work. Not theoretical frameworks, but practical systems I use every day. The key realization? Most productivity systems fail because they skip the foundation. They give you tactics before clarity. I learned the hard way that knowing your values, principles, and goals isn't optional; it's where everything else starts. Today, I manage nearly 10,000 notes in my personal vault and I'm almost always calm, despite a demanding life. The Knowledge Worker Kit is everything I wish I had when I started.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized tactics fail without foundation. You need clarity first

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of Building Systems
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not theory. Practice.
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. In my IT career, I've been a software developer, technical lead, software architect, solution architect, infrastructure architect, IT security expert, team leader, project manager, CTO, and founder. Today, I work half-time as an IT Solution Architect for a major financial organization in Belgium while running DeveloPassion, raising 3 kids, and maintaining nearly 10,000 notes in my personal knowledge system. I've published 3 books, written 400+ articles and newsletters, created courses, built digital products, and launched the Knowii community. My system works. I want it to work for you too. This isn't content from someone who researched productivity for a blog post. This is a living system from someone who builds his life around these principles.
